propositions: code-review-verify spec outputs no decision polarity (only {verifications: [...]}), causing _verdict_decision to fall through to advisory for all cases regardless of gold label
V-real-defect gold-block case is guaranteed recall miss because both v1 and v2 emit advisory decision when verifications list is present
Naively mapping non-empty verifications to block would fix the recall miss but would incorrectly score V-clean-rename (gold advisory) as block, manufacturing a false accept
code-review-verify must be excluded from parity corpus via a separate POLARITY_FREE_SOLVERS mechanism distinct from AGENTIC_SOLVERS to preserve the reason and prevent silent re-admission
Excluding both verify cases reduces n_gold from 28 to 26 (still above MIN_GOLD_ITEMS threshold of 20) and raises recall on both arms without changing gating verdicts
Offline re-scoring shows bedrock true recall is 1.000 not 0.929, correcting measurement accuracy for the spec's actual performance on safe-item gates
